hero
This is Motherbrain: a persistent memory for Omega agents. Many agents attach to one brain, so when one agent learns, the whole fleet learns.
stages
Memory works in stages, like a human brain. Short-term runs on the fast mini model. Long-term memory and dreams run on ASI one.
scout

Everything from here is live. Two real agents connect over MCP. Omega scout asks the brain first and finds nothing. It plans with ASI one and calls a real export tool, which fails on a data policy it couldn't have known about. So it writes a hard lesson for the fleet.
soul
That lesson rewrites the shared soul file instantly, and every agent is told to re-read it. No reboot.
ops
Now Hermes ops gets a similar job. It never saw the failure, but the brain hands it the lesson before it plans, and it succeeds on the first try.
before_after
Failed once. Lesson written. Didn't fail again.
dream
Then the brain dreams. The stronger model consolidates what the fleet learned today, live, in seconds.
refusal
When a model refuses, Motherbrain says what was declined and why, logs it, and never tries to force it.
plans
Free on the mini brain. Pro is five dollars per agent.
connect
There's a native Omega plugin, and any agent can join over MCP. Try it at motherbrain dot vercel dot app.
